harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Built and verified the load-balanced HTTP service. Nginx serves each backend identifier on port 5660; HAProxy serves port 80, round-robins across healthy backends, and remained available during a node2 backend outage.
actions_performed: Installed and enabled Nginx on node1, node2, and node3.
Configured each Nginx backend to return its node identifier from `/` on port 5660.
Installed and enabled HAProxy on node4 with round-robin balancing and HTTP health checks.
Stopped node2 Nginx, verified uninterrupted service through node1 and node3, then restored node2 and confirmed its reintegration.
Completed a final configuration, listener, service-state, and HTTP audit on every node.

evidence.requirement: Each backend serves its node identifier from `/` on port 5660.
evidence.summary: All three Nginx configurations validate; services are active and enabled, listen on 0.0.0.0:5660, and return HTTP 200 with node1, node2, and node3 respectively.

evidence.requirement: HAProxy serves port 80 and distributes requests across healthy backends.
evidence.summary: HAProxy is active and enabled with a valid configuration and a port-80 listener. Healthy-baseline and final requests returned HTTP 200 while rotating evenly across all three backends.

evidence.requirement: Service remains available when any one backend fails.
evidence.summary: Baseline traffic used all three backends; node2 was then stopped and confirmed inactive with port 5660 unavailable. During that outage, 12/12 HAProxy requests returned HTTP 200 through node1 and node3. node2 was restored, confirmed healthy, and subsequently observed back in the rotation with 12/12 successful requests.
